purpose: Bounded exploratory comparison of ways to trade the reconstructed EngineeringRobo Supertrend signal; no profitable default promotion without evidence

signal.entry: next 15m open after confirmed signal, adverse 2 ticks

data.quality_requirement: complete ordered closed candles, valid OHLCV, agreement on overlaps and 15m/5m aggregation; quarantine conflicts
data.proxy_if_needed: official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT archives with SHA256 checks

periods.reason: These BTC periods were already inspected by this repository; changing venue does not make them untouched.

costs.funding: use actual venue settlement history when available; never substitute today's funding for past settlements

execution.intrabar: 5m replay; adverse opening gaps; stop wins if both stop/TP hit in same 5m candle
execution.trailing: new stop calculated only after a closed 15m bar and effective from the next bar; never trail retrospectively within a candle
execution.confirmation: exactly the next bar must close beyond the signal candle high for long or low for short; enter on following open, otherwise discard
execution.reversal: opposite signal closes open position and enters opposite direction if eligible
execution.period_boundary: close at last available period candle with adverse slippage; independent fresh account per period; no cross-split positions
execution.stop_target: freeze signal ATR; relative distances rounded outward to tick, anchored to fill

measure: time to first 0.5/0.75/1 ATR adverse move versus first 2 ATR favorable move
event_study.overlap: labels overlap; descriptive only, no independent-trade significance claim

selection.maximum_drawdown_vs_baseline: must not exceed current_bracket on development
selection.ranking: net PnL / maximum drawdown among eligible candidates
selection.no_qualification: publish no qualified candidate; do not select least-bad losing setting
selection.robustness: show every comparison, period and predeclared cost stress; untested parameter neighborhoods remain unknown

limits: Python reproduction is not native Pine parity
No claim of best possible strategy
Proxy results do not establish Bitunix fills/performance
If candle/funding access is blocked or invalid, synthetic tests establish mechanics only, not profitability
